title: 3.1.11b Lab — Animate with frameCount
description: Drive a Cube's Y rotation using frameCount so it spins at a steady rate each frame.

steps.title: Create a Cube
steps.instructions: In setup(), create a Cube at (0, 0, 0) and store it in the `cube` variable.
hints: Give it a color — a colorful cube shows rotation more clearly.

steps.title: Animate with frameCount in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), set `cube.rotation.y = frameCount * 0.02` to spin the cube at a steady rate.
hints: frameCount grows by 1 each frame. Multiplying by 0.02 controls the spin speed. Try 0.01 for slower, 0.05 for faster.
